title: Maximum Subarray Sum
statement_md:
Given an array of N integers, find the maximum sum of a contiguous subarray (Kadane's algorithm territory).

**Input**
Line 1: N
Line 2: N space-separated integers (each with |a_i| <= 10^9)

**Output**
A single integer: the maximum subarray sum.
hints: The answer is the max over j of prefix[j] minus the smallest prefix before j.
Scan once while tracking the minimum prefix sum seen so far.
Kadane's algorithm is the same idea: restart the running sum when it goes negative.
